hypotheses.construction_plan: Define H(x)=V(x)*G0(x)*V(x). Substitute x=p for the first term and x=q for the second term; the raw expression is the sum of these two instantiations.
hypotheses.rationale: The two additive terms have identical compositional structure V(_)*G0(_)*V(_) with only the declared symbol p or q changing, so they are evaluations of a single parameterized object H(x).
